title: An affine scheme is reduced iff its ring is reduced
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\operatorname{Spec}R$ its spectrum [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then the scheme $\operatorname{Spec}R$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] if and only if $R$ is a reduced ring (has no nonzero nilpotent element).

the reduced subscheme X_red defined by the nilradical ideal sheaf is a reduced scheme
